2609.01286.title: Analog-DB: An Agent-First Analog Integrated Circuit Database, From Blocks to Systems
2609.01286.paper_summary: Sharing analog integrated circuit designs remains difficult: foundry non-disclosure agreements restrict the process details a design depends on, and the testbenches behind published results are rarely released. We present analog-db, an open-source, versioned database built on a shareable design representation. A domain-specific language captures each design as a process-neutral topology, reusable testbenches, and a machine-readable datasheet under one schema, so a design is shared in full and re-simulates on the process kits it is bound to. A parameterization scheme exposes functional sub-blocks and device sizes as named parameters that carry their matching constraints, making circuits composable and retargetable; a schema-governed contract and queryable catalog let AI design agents discover and reuse them directly. Across the regulator corpus, all 23 circuit-kit bindings on three open kits meet their own recorded specification bands (typical corner, matched devices, no layout) and 10 of 23 meet a common class band. Seventeen of the 23 imported sizings failed their testbenches and closed under a gm/ID sizing loop driven by the annotated sub-block roles, typically within one to three iterations. In a supervised case study, a coding agent working from the released artifacts sized the op-amp cores of a chopper instrumentation amplifier on an open 130nm kit, locating four hand-entry defects and a missing common-mode feedback loop that the sizing-only baseline did not repair. The database holds 68 circuits across sixteen classes, verifiable at schematic level under a tiered harness and tracked on a power/performance scoreboard, released at https://github.com/MacAnalog/spicexplorer-release.
2609.01286.paper_summary_zh: 分享類比集成電路設計仍然困難：鑄造廠的保密協議限制了設計所依賴的過程細節，而發表結果背後的測試平台很少被釋出。 我們提出了analog-db，一個基於可共享設計表示的開源版本資料庫。 一種特定領域的語言將每個設計捕捉為過程中立的拓撲、可重用的測試平台和在一個架構下的機器可讀數據表，因此設計可以完整共享並在其所依賴的過程工具上重新模擬。 一個參數化方案將功能子模塊和設備大小暴露為帶有其匹配約束的命名參數，使電路可組合和可重新定位；一個架構治理的合約和可查詢的目錄使AI設計代理能夠直接發現和重用它們。 在調節器語料庫中，三個開放工具上的所有23個電路工具綁定都符合其自身記錄的規範帶（典型角落、匹配設備、無佈局），而23個中有10個符合共同類別帶。 23個導入的尺寸中有17個未通過其測試平台，並在由註解子模塊角色驅動的gm/ID尺寸循環中關閉，通常在一到三次迭代內。 在一個監督案例研究中，一個從釋出工件工作的編碼代理在一個開放的130nm工具上對一個切換儀器放大器的運算放大器核心進行了尺寸設置，定位了四個手動輸入缺陷和一個缺失的共模反饋迴路，而僅基於尺寸的基準並未修復。 該資料庫包含68個電路，跨越十六個類別，在分層的繩索下可在原理圖層級進行驗證，並在功率/性能記分板上進行追蹤，已發佈於 https://github.com/MacAnalog/spicexplorer-release。
